newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 24.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Friday morning edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Directors of big enterprises live like feudal lords while their workers believe that the government is responsible for the non-payment of their salaries, says a top official of the state tax service in a reference to a widespread practice of evasion of taxes by industrial bosses.
- Most Russian medical institutions due to receive equipment under a World Bank loan have no money to cover customs and storage services, says a deputy health minister.
- A Ukrainian scientific institute, which studies livestock breeding reseach, has worked out its own method of embryo cloning.
- Police in Novosibirsk are recruiting local farmers to hunt abandoned dogs in the outskirts of the city.
